Dare not speak the name of the Master of Whispers – not unless you have a good reason for doing so. This cryptic figure is so mysterious that he's hidden his real name; instead, he's always addressed by his title. The Master of Whispers has unquestioned command of an [[Order of Whispers|efficient organization]], although many debate what form his authority actually takes. One rumor holds that he's the province's spymaster, keeping a job where he serves as a central collector of information from spies across the nation (and perhaps beyond). Others believe he deals with supernatural threats, training his agents as ghost seekers and [[demon]] hunters. Whatever the truth may be, he often finds reason for traveling with adventurers exploring [[Elona]] (and perhaps beyond). His reasons for doing so are strictly on a need-to-know basis. You're just not ready to learn that yet.}} The [[Master of Whispers]] is the leader of the secret organization known as the Order of Whispers. He is a [[wikipedia:Spymaster|spymaster]] and adviser to the player character in matters of intelligence and espionage. Although he is always referred to by his title, his real name is '''Jurah'''. ==Locations== *[[Kourna]] **[[Dejarin Estate]] (before completion of [[To Kill a Demon]]) **[[Jahai Bluffs]] (during [[Centaur Blackmail]] and [[Secrets in the Shadow]]) **[[The Floodplain of Mahnkelon]] (during To Kill a Demon) *[[Realm of Torment]] **[[Throne of Secrets]] ==Missions== :''R indicates that the Master of Whispers must be in the party'' *[[Kourna]] **[[Rilohn Refuge]] R *[[Vabbi]] **[[Dzagonur Bastion]] R ==Quests== :''R indicates that the Master of Whispers must be in the party'' '''Quests given:''' *[[Secrets in the Shadow]] *[[To Kill a Demon]] *[[Gain Master of Whispers]] '''Quests involved in:''' *[[Centaur Blackmail]] *[[Mysterious Message (Nightfall quest)|Mysterious Message]] *[[Calling the Order]] R *[[Data Mining]] R *[[To the Rescue (Nightfall quest)|To the Rescue]] R *[[Coffer of Joko]] R *[[Puzzling Parchment]] R ==Recruitment== [[File:MasterOfWhispersUnlocked.jpg|right]] Complete the primary quest [[To Kill a Demon]], which is the follow-up quest to [[Secrets in the Shadow]]. Secrets in the Shadow is offered right after completion of the [[Mysterious Message (Nightfall quest)|Mysterious Message]] quest, together with a mutually exclusive primary quest [[For a Price]]. The latter quest leads to the recruitment of [[Margrid the Sly]]. As such, completing For a Price will prevent the recruitment of Master of Whispers until after the completion of the Nightfall campaign where you can receive the quest [[Gain Master of Whispers]] to recruit him. ==Skills== ;Hero default skills *{{skill icon|Enfeebling Blood}} *{{skill icon|Envenom Enchantments}} *{{skill icon|Faintheartedness}} *{{skill icon|Life Siphon}} *{{skill icon|Vampiric Gaze}} *{{skill icon|Resurrection Signet}} ==Armor== The Master of Whispers starts out with Mysterious Armor, an armor art type unique to him. The appearance of his armor can be upgraded to [[Ancient armor]] using [[Ancient Armor Remnants]] acquired from the [[Remains of Sahlahja]] [[Challenge Mission]]. The appearance of his armor can also be upgraded to [[Primeval armor]] using [[Primeval Armor Remnants]] acquired in the [[Domain of Anguish]] and during [[the Ebony Citadel of Mallyx]] mission. See Master of Whispers's [[Master of Whispers/Armor gallery|armor gallery]]. ==Dialogue== Jahai Bluffs and Dejarin Estate: :''"No need to introduce yourself. I know exactly who you are and what you're capable of. Half the people you've met in [[Istan]] work for me, whether they realize it or not. My name? That is unimportant. All you need know is that I am an ally, and that I know as much about our enemies as I do about you."'' Throne of Secrets: :''"The [[Order of Whispers]] is indebted to you for all that you have done. [[Elona]] does not know the full extent of your actions. Pity."'' :''"Your death is most regrettable... but not to me."'' ==Notes== *A duplicate Master of Whispers will show up as an "Elonian Necromancer". *Master of Whispers' default weapon is a customized blue [[Unholy Staff]] with Energy +10, 11-22 cold damage, an attribute requirement of 9 Curses and Halves skill recharge of spells (Chance: 20%). *As with all heroes, this one has a [[Everlasting Master of Whispers Tonic|tonic form]]. ==Trivia== *The voice actor for this character is [[Keith Szarabajka]]. {{gw2w}} {{Heroes nav}}
